The following events took place in '''1050 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''. This year was known as '''Year 2,603''' after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], '''Year 50''' before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], and '''Year 1,015''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Births==
*[[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], is born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>
*[[Kerra Holt]], on [[Aquilaris]]<ref name="Aflame 2">[[Knight Errant 2|''Knight Errant'' 2]]</ref>
